children: Branded tech peripherals firm's Q3 net sales fell 0.9% and slightly missed analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 rose, benefiting from tariff refunds
Company closed Trust acquisition and raised full-year outlook to reflect tariff refunds and deal
Company expects 2026 reported sales to rise 4.0% to 6.0%, including Trust acquisition
Company sees 2026 full-year adjusted EPS at $0.98 to $1.02, including tariff refund
Company expects 2026 free cash flow of about $100 mln and year-end leverage ratio of 3.5x
TARIFF REFUNDS - Net tariff refunds boosted operating income and adjusted EPS by $15.1 mln in Q3
TECH PERIPHERALS SOFTNESS - Co said lower demand for technology peripherals contributed to a 6.2% decline in comparable sales
COST SAVINGS - Cost savings helped lift adjusted operating income, partly offset by lower product mix
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support supplies peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for ACCO Brands Corp is $9.00, about 105.5% above its October 28 closing price of $4.38
The stock recently traded at 5 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 5 three months ago
